mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, type_code, type, level, institution_nature, devices, workers, sum_people, beds, province, city, county, country, unit_head, telephone, lon AS longitude, -- 关键：给lon字段起别名，匹配实体类的longitude属性 lat AS latitude, -- 关键：给lat字段起别名，匹配实体类的latitude属性 ST_AsText(point) AS geomText -- 保留原geomText字段 FROM xian_hospitals WHERE POWER( (ST_X(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) - ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * COS(#{rotation} * PI() / 180) + (ST_Y(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) - ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * SIN(#{rotation} * PI() / 180), 2 ) / POWER(#{semiMajorAxis}, 2) + POWER( - (ST_X(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) - ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * SIN(#{rotation} * PI() / 180) + (ST_Y(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) - ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * COS(#{rotation} * PI() / 180), 2 ) / POWER(#{semiMinorAxis}, 2) <= 1
